rows.name: proximal_outcome_alternation
rows.comment: frequency at which proximal outcomes questions are asked (every other check-in)

rows.name: proximal_outcome_post_frequency
rows.comment: days between check-ins after programme completion

rows.name: proximal_outcome_due_from
rows.comment: Which timestamp decides when the next check-in is due: "viewed" (intro shown) or "started" (intro's next pressed). More values can be added later.

rows.name: proximal_outcome_hidden_pages
rows.comment: Check-in pages to hide, by page id, separated by spaces (e.g. goal_refl  or  goal_refl qs_base_2). none = show all. Applies to both the 7-day and 14-day check-ins. Never hide intro. exclude_from_translation must stay TRUE (the value is page ids).
